statement: Hemalurgy can transfer Allomantic or Feruchemical powers; its outcome depends on how and where the spike is used. This does not define a complete binding-point map.
implementation: PowerGrant stores the art, metal and source. Extraction and binding points are deferred.

statement: Represent each grant independently and retain its origin. Removing one source preserves unrelated grants. This is a data-model interpretation, not a complete account of spiritweb damage.
implementation: PowerGrant and Spiritweb.withoutSource; no spike insertion/removal gameplay.

statement: For the Phase 1 access display, use the strongest applicable grant. Preserve every grant so later canon research can revise stacking without losing provenance.
implementation: Spiritweb.strength; no additive strength or effect engine.

statement: Reserve distinct item and Identity UUIDs. An absent Identity field does not itself grant permission to tap an item. Charge units remain abstract pending the attribute engine.
implementation: Identity/charge persist through invested slicing, brewing and ingestion. Access checks, storage and tapping mechanics are deferred.

statement: New characters begin without powers. Player spiritweb data copies on death; active effects are never persisted. Acquisition and death balance remain future design decisions.
implementation: Persistent Fabric attachment with copyOnDeath. No active-effect fields.

statement: God metals, anatomical binding points, Compounding, Fortune, Connection and unsealed metalmind behavior remain unresolved. Current alloy ratios are explicit gameplay interpretations rather than verified universal canonical quantities.
implementation: Advanced powers remain unimplemented. Eight interpreted alloy formulas are implemented in Phase 2.

statement: The eight alloy ratios are documented gameplay interpretations. Exact and off-ratio batches are distinguished; these numbers are not claimed to be verified universal canon.
implementation: Data-driven alloy recipes with composition and viable/imperfect/invalid outcomes.

statement: One ingot equals nine nuggets, nine hundred measured portions, or nine grams of credited metal. Ore recovery yields and silicon/carbon processing are game abstractions, not real smelting chemistry.
implementation: Integer mass bookkeeping and recipe-conservation tests. Zinc refining credits eight zinc nuggets plus one cadmium nugget.

statement: Non-Allomantic and off-ratio metals are refused by the brewing/drinking path rather than inventing canonical injury values. Drinking transfers fuel without granting access or activating a power.
implementation: Server-side vial validation. Invested slicing and ingestion preserve residual mass, charge and Identity.
